raw: {"analysis":"Response JHM correctly sequences the downstream validation as dependent on having a staging endpoint available, and properly accounts for the 200-credit cost per CI run by capping synthetic runs. Response SVF incorrectly states that Lane B (downstream validation) can run parallel to Lane A (configuration) without a staging endpoint, proposes an incremental traffic shift (10%, 50%, 100%) that contradicts the blue-green swap requirement, and wastes credits by allowing up to three manual re-triggers of the flaky certificate-validation check. Response JHM also correctly identifies the dual-sign-off requirement (Security Lead + Platform Director) while keeping Jane Smith's merge authorization distinct, whereas SVF conflates the approval hierarchy.","verdict":"JHM"}
